components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single accent action per view (Add account, Review now, Sign in).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: var(--button-radius, 8px); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-h); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral / dismiss action next to a primary (Later, row Edit/Record).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--muted); font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--soft); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link Button
components.css: .ds-btn-link { border: none; background: none; padding: 0; color: var(--accent); font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-link:hover { color: var(--accent-h); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The flat white surface for every section, on the warm-paper ground.
components.html:
Accounts
Flat surface, 1px hairline, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); } .ds-card-body { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Summary Stat
components.description: A single labeled figure in tabular numerals — the dashboard's summary cards.
components.html:
Net cash flow
+Rs 128,400
income − expenses
components.css: .ds-stat { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); } .ds-stat-value { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--pos); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat-sub { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Single-line input; focus recolors the field's own edge with no external halo.
components.css: .ds-field { height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted); } .ds-field:focus { outline: 1px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item (active)
components.description: Active navigation row — soft-teal fill, teal icon, ink label at weight 600.
components.html: All Accounts
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); } .ds-nav svg { color: var(--muted); flex: none; } .ds-nav:hover { background: var(--elev); } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--soft); color: var(--text); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-active svg { color: var(--accent); }

components.name: List Row
components.description: Dense row with a label/sub stack and a right-aligned tabular figure; hairline divider (removed on the last row of a list).
components.html: HBL CurrentHBLRs 84,210
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-row-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--pos); flex: none; } .ds-row-main { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-row-name { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text); } .ds-row-sub { display: block; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-row-amt { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Bar Meter
components.description: A track rail with a teal (or category-colored) fill; flat CSS, small radius.
components.css: .ds-meter { height: 8px; background: var(--track); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Raqam is a manual-entry personal-finance app: every figure on screen was typed in by the person reading it, and the product's promise is that those figures can be trusted. The visual system earns that trust through calm and precision, not persuasion — numbers lead, the interface recedes. A warm-paper page carries flat white cards separated by hairline borders, with a single deep-teal accent used sparingly for what you can act on. All monetary figures use tabular numerals so columns align to the pixel. Depth is built without shadows: three paper tones and 1px hairlines do the layering; the one soft shadow is reserved for drawers and dialogs.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white ground; flat white cards; 1px hairline separation, never shadow.
One teal accent, used only on interactive and actionable elements.
Tabular numerals for every monetary figure — alignment is non-negotiable.
Small, consistent radii; refined and restrained controls.
Status color earns its place; it is a signal, not decoration.

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only chromatic voice in the primary UI, and it appears only on things the user can act on. If an element is not interactive or actionable, it is neutral. Rarity is what makes the accent legible.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Rule
rules.body: Status hues (green/amber/red/blue) are signals about money or state, never styling. A red that isn't reporting a negative, or a green that isn't reporting a positive, is a bug.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every monetary figure uses tabular numerals (the .tnum class). Amounts must align vertically wherever they stack and must not reflow horizontally as digits change.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Face Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is created with weight (500 to 600 to 700) and size, never with a second font, italics, or color.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: If it lives in the page, it is flat — bordered and tonally layered, never shadowed. The only shadow in Raqam floats a drawer or dialog over the app. A resting shadow on a card is a defect.

dos: Do set every monetary figure in tabular numerals (.tnum); keep stacked amounts aligned.
Do build depth from the three paper tones and 1px hairlines; keep in-page surfaces flat.
Do reserve teal for interactive and actionable elements, and keep it rare.
Do carry callout/severity meaning with a soft background fill plus status text color.
Do use container queries against content width for responsive changes (stack the dashboard body at 820px, the Plan grid at 1100px).
Do create emphasis with weight and size steps in Figtree.
donts: Don't put a resting shadow on any card, row, or in-page surface — shadow is for drawers/dialogs only.
Don't add a colored or thick side-border (accent bar) to cards, banners, or callouts.
Don't introduce a second typeface, italics, or gradient text for emphasis.
Don't use status color decoratively — a hue must report real money or state.
Don't let the primary column exceed 1180px, and don't leave a list's final row with a trailing divider.
Don't assume viewport media queries; the resizable sidebar means content width is not viewport width.
